title: Prometheus metrics on the KEDA Metrics Server are deprecated in favour of the Operator's

detection.reason: which endpoint a Prometheus scrape config, ServiceMonitor or dashboard reads is not in the collected projection

quote: Prometheus metrics on KEDA Metric Server are deprecated in favor of Prometheus metrics on KEDA Operator (#3972 | Discussion)
remediation: Point every scrape job and dashboard that reads the keda-metrics-apiserver /metrics endpoint at the keda-operator metrics port (chart `prometheus.operator.enabled`) instead. Nothing stops working on this hop; 2.11 removes the metrics-server endpoint.
verifyCommand: kubectl get servicemonitors.monitoring.coreos.com,podmonitors.monitoring.coreos.com -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("keda")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a KEDA scrape target to re-point at the operator

title: Azure Event Hubs: the default `azureFunction` checkpoint strategy is deprecated

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: Default checkpointing strategy for Azure Event Hubs scaler `azureFunctions` is deprecated in favor of `blobMetadata` (#XXX | Discussion)
remediation: On each azure-eventhub trigger named, set `checkpointStrategy` explicitly (`blobMetadata` for non-Functions consumers, or the one your consumer actually writes) instead of relying on the default. A trigger that already sets it is listed too and needs no edit. (The code spells the strategy `azureFunction`; the changelog's `azureFunctions` is a typo.)
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select(.type == "azure-eventhub") | select((.metadata // {}) | has("checkpointStrategy") | not) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row is an azure-eventhub trigger; checkpointStrategy=null relies on the deprecated default

title: `metadata.type` on cpu / memory / datadog triggers is deprecated in favour of `metricType`

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: `metadata.type` is deprecated in favor of the global `metricType` for CPU, Memory, Datadog scalers (#2844 | Discussion)
remediation: On each trigger named, delete `metadata.type` and set the trigger-level `metricType` (Utilization | AverageValue | Value) instead. The key keeps working on this hop; KEDA 2.18 removes it for cpu and memory and the scaler then refuses the trigger. (First announced in 2.7.0; 2.9 lists it again.)
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "cpu" or .type == "memory" or .type == "datadog") and (.metadata // {} | has("type"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row still sets metadata.type

title: ScaledJob `rolloutStrategy` is deprecated in favour of `rollout.strategy`
quote: `rolloutStrategy` is deprecated in favor of `rollout.strategy` in ScaledJobs (#3596 | Discussion)
remediation: Move the value of `spec.rolloutStrategy` (gradual | immediate) to `spec.rollout.strategy` on each ScaledJob named. The old field still works on every 2.x release and has never been removed, so nothing breaks on the hop — this is the cleanup to schedule before it is.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.rolloutStrategy != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) rolloutStrategy=\(.spec.rolloutStrategy)"'  # each row still sets the deprecated field

title: Redis scalers verify the server certificate when `enableTLS` is set — a self-signed or private-CA Redis stops scaling

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned; the enableTLS VALUE and an unsafeSsl key are not subtracted, so a trigger with `enableTLS: "false"` or one that already sets `unsafeSsl` is listed too

quote: **Redis Scalers**: Support `unsafeSsl` and enable ssl verification as default (#4005)
remediation: Before 2.9.1 `enableTLS: "true"` also switched certificate verification OFF (the client was built with `InsecureSkipVerify: enableTLS`, redis_scaler.go v2.9.0:462,486,507). From 2.9.1 the server certificate is verified. On each trigger named that enables TLS against a Redis whose certificate is self-signed or from a private CA, set `unsafeSsl: "true"` on the trigger to keep the old behaviour, or (from 2.12) supply the CA through the TriggerAuthentication's `ca` parameter. A trigger with TLS off, or a Redis with a publicly trusted certificate, needs no change.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type | test("^redis")) and ((.metadata // {}).enableTLS == "true") and ((.metadata // {}).unsafeSsl != "true")) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row verifies the Redis certificate from 2.9.1 on; it needs a publicly trusted cert, a CA, or unsafeSsl
